{{Quote|Despite what General Var Suthra believes, I've known about this outpost for some time. Your imminent arrival forced me to take action. My mission is to protect the Empire from Doctor Godera's weapons. I'm afraid I can't let you have him.|Watcher One|<ref name="The Architect of Annihilation" />}}
Near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] forces under the command of [[Watcher One]] '''attacked''' a [[Resettlement Zone laboratory|laboratory]] of the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]] in the [[Republic Resettlement Zone]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Watcher One, an [[operative]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], was searching for Godera and was successful in using the facility to triangulate Godera's location, though after he departed the [[Imperial soldier]]s were [[Death/Legends|killed]] when a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] and a companion arrived at the lab in search of Godera. Watcher One deployed [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] equipped with [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generators]] to take the Knight by surprise, but the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] emerged victorious and continued the race to locate Godera.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The Republic is recolonizing Taris. Recently, we found evidence that our missing doctor has been here for years. Reconnaissance discovered one of Godera's outposts in the swamp. It's entirely automated. Nothing but droids inside, and they're not cooperating.|General Var Suthra|<ref name="The Architect of Annihilation" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|duel]] with a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] when Tarnis attempted to use the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] against the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Tarnis's death incurred the wrath of his [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Darth Angral]], who declared a [[Desolator crisis|war of vengeance]] upon the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in retribution, and Angral dispatched his three [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]] to capture several Republic superweapon projects that Tarnis&mdash;who had been posing as a Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] before his death&mdash;had told his father about.<ref name="Race to the Ruins">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Race to the Ruins|Coruscant}}</ref>

Tarnis also conveyed information indicating that [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nasan Godera]], a brilliant Republic scientist who had left the Republic after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] ended the [[Great Galactic War]] with the Empire a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] [[3653 BBY|prior]], was on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Angral therefore dispatched [[Watcher One]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] to Taris with a number of [[Imperial soldier]]s to retrieve Godera. Watcher One knew of the existence of a number of underground [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratories]] belonging to Godera, though the facilities were staffed only by [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and he began searching the planet for Godera himself. However, Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] dispatched the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had killed Tarnis; the Knight's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Kira Carsen]]; and the Knight's [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]], [[T7-O1]], to Taris to also look for Godera.<ref name="The Architect of Annihilation" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|As fortune would have it, Doctor Godera will be in my custody shortly. You've already failed. I see my reinforcements are finally in position.|Watcher One|<ref name="The Architect of Annihilation" />}}
[[File:Operative_in_lab.png|thumb|left|180px|One of the Imperial operatives decloaks.]]
When Watcher One became aware of the trio's arrival, he led a unit of Imperial [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth]] [[operative]]s, [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], and Imperial Intelligence [[Officer/Legends|officers]] to secure the [[Resettlement Zone laboratory|lab]] in the [[Republic Resettlement Zone]], the closest facility to the Republic's [[Olaris]] Reclamation Base, where the Jedi had landed. The Resettlement Zone facility had already been discovered by the Republic, and General Suthra had stationed a small team of four [[Republic trooper]]s at the facility to monitor it. Watcher One's forces quickly wiped out the droid staff and Suthra's team, and used the facility's [[tracking relay]]s to trace Godera's bioscan to a [[Brell Sediment laboratory|laboratory]] in the [[Brell Sediment]] area. He left after destroying the central [[Computer/Legends|computer]] to prevent others from doing the same, leaving his [[Gender/Legends|men]] behind to guard the lab. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and a companion soon arrived and fought their way through the Imperial forces that they encountered as they descended into the now-wrecked lab, and the two defeated almost a dozen Imperial stealth operatives and battle droids as they cleared the lab of hostiles. An Imperial [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and two [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] attacked the pair on the lower level, but they too were defeated.<ref name="The Architect of Annihilation" />

The assassin had been speaking with Watcher One via a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], and Watcher One&mdash;already on his way to Godera's location&mdash;addressed the Jedi as the Knight approached the device. The [[Agent/Legends|agent]] also contacted his forces nearby and dispatched a number of operatives and droids to the lab. Speaking to the Jedi, Watcher One began to stall for [[Time/Legends|time]] so that his operatives could get into place, revealing his knowledge of the Jedi's [[Flesh Raider uprising|exploits]] on the Jedi Order's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] as a way of undermining the Knight's confidence. When the Knight brushed off Watcher One's comments, Watcher One ordered his operatives to [[Cloaking device/Legends|decloak]] and take out the Jedi before he terminated the transmission. Despite their advantage of surprise, however, the three Imperial operatives and two droids who attacked the Knight were ultimately defeated by the Jedi and the Knight's companion.<ref name="The Architect of Annihilation" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Watcher One reprogrammed this facility's tracking relays. He traced Doctor Godera's encrypted bioscan to its present location.|RE-M0|<ref name="Catching Up With Watcher One" />}}
After defeating Watcher One's forces, the Jedi was greeted by Godera's droid assistant [[RE-M0]], who had remained hidden when the Imperials attacked the lab.<ref name="The Architect of Annihilation" /> RE-M0 then repaired the central computer while the Knight reset the external tracking relays around the area. With the droid's help, the Jedi tracked Godera's biosignature to the Brell Sediment lab just in time to encounter Watcher One's forces securing the facility, though Watcher One escaped with Godera in the resultant [[Battle in the Brell Sediment laboratory|fight]]. However, RE-M0 ran a second bioscan on Godera shortly after the Jedi departed, and he was able to detect that Godera had been moved from that lab. He followed the Jedi to the Brell Sediment lab and warned the Knight of Watcher One's deception, exposing the Imperial's attempt to convince the Jedi that Godera was dead.<ref name="Catching Up With Watcher One" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Resettlement Zone lab first appeared in "The Architect of Annihilation," a mission for the Jedi Knight class in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="The Architect of Annihilation" />
